newsitem.title: USA: BLC Financial says Q2 oper revenues up.
newsitem.headline: BLC Financial says Q2 oper revenues up.

text.p: BLC Financial Services Inc. said Friday its revenue from operations for second quarter ended December 31, 1996 climbed to $1.2 million, up from $622,000 for the same period in 1995.

It said its net income rose to $316,000 compared to a net loss of $8,000 per share for the quarter a year ago. Net income per share for the second quarter was $0.02 a share, against none for the similar period in 1995.
It said its loan portfolio rose to $75.3 million for the December 31 quarter, compared to $58.6 million for the comparable quarter in 1995.
As a result, service fee income increased by 137 percent while interest income rose by 13 percent, it said.

It said it also had a greater loan originations and subsequent loan sales during the quarter ending December 31, compared to the prior year's period. It said this resulted in an increase in the gain recognized upon the sale of loans guaranteed by the Small Business Administration in the secondary market.
BLC Financial originates, sells and services loans to small businesses under the guaranteed loan program sponsored by the SBA.
